prefix: Production game asset, One Piece browser RPG. ONE character sprite sheet. Subject:
suffix: FOUR distinct full-body poses in ONE horizontal row: idle guard, ready, attack, hurt. All face right, feet aligned. Crisp detailed 16-bit pixel art with black outlines and limited shading. Each pose fits wholly inside its own equal cell with generous TRANSPARENT gaps; no touching or overlap. Entire weapons, hair, tails and accessories visible. Actual transparent RGBA background. No text, labels, border, ground or watermark. No blood. Match a classic pixel fighting-game sprite, not a portrait.

assets.loki: Loki, prince of Elbaph: magenta hair with front braids, black horned Viking helmet, bandaged eyes, purple fur cloak, dark trousers, giant rectangular steel warhammer Ragnir.
assets.shamrock: Figarland Shamrock: Shanks-like face WITHOUT scars, BOTH arms, long red hair with small side braid, black and gold military tailcoat, white trousers, red gloves, tall brown and gold boots, golden saber.
assets.gunko: Manmayer Gunko: adult woman, short light blue bob, mismatched eyes, black cap and goggles, black military jacket with white fur collar, shorts and tall boots, blue arrow ribbons around fists. No devil wings.
assets.sommers: Shepherd Sommers: tall muscular older man, orange blond pigtails, short crucifix-shaped beard, red sunglasses, purple tunic with gold buttons and rose, white gloves, purple tall boots, black-red fur collar cape, sword covered in thorn vines.
assets.killingham: Rimoshifu Killingham in human form: tall slender adult man, messy black neck-length hair, sleepy eyes, sharp teeth, orange military tunic and coat with gold buttons, white cravat, black trousers, orange boots, bubble helmet and orange respirator.
assets.harald: King Harald of Elbaph: enormous muscular elderly giant king, long pale hair and beard, broken horn stumps, royal crown and red fur-trimmed cape, Viking armor and massive sword. Regal, kind eyes.
assets.road: Road from One Piece: very tall slender male giant navigator, long dark hair, thin mustache, black top hat with goggles, dark coat with fluffy collar, long trousers, large axe. No Sun God skull costume.
assets.gerd: Gerd, female giant warrior from One Piece: very long blond hair, side braid, horned Viking helmet, green striped warrior tunic dress with brown belt, boots, massive battleaxe. Powerful athletic adult.
assets.goldberg: Goldberg, giant pirate from One Piece: very large round male Viking warrior, brown hair and beard, horned helmet, striped shirt, fur shoulder cloak, broad wooden round shield and club. Cheerful stout silhouette.
assets.stansen: Stansen from One Piece, muscular male giant shipwright, short spiky brown hair, chin beard, goggles on forehead, sleeveless work clothes, leather gloves and heavy hammer.
assets.saul: Jaguar D. Saul in Elbaph: smiling huge stocky giant, bushy orange beard, long orange hair, bandages and burn scars, simple wide-brim hat, patched blue coat and shorts, missing lower left leg with a wooden prosthesis. Carries a large book, uses fists.
assets.jarul: Jarul, elderly Mountain Beard giant of Elbaph: enormous extremely long white beard, horned Viking helmet pierced by a sword sticking through it, aged face, dark fur cape, simple Viking clothes and axe. Full helmet sword must fit in frame.
assets.ripley: Ripley from One Piece, athletic adult female giant warrior, long light hair shaved short on one side, bold geometric dark tattoos on arms and shoulder, sleeveless black warrior top, belt and Viking skirt, boots. Bare-knuckle stance.
assets.colon: Colon, young giant boy from Elbaph: short red hair, small Viking helmet, red tunic, short trousers, boots, toy-sized axe, determined adventurous face. Child-appropriate fully clothed outfit, no injury or blood.
assets.ange: Ange, adult female giant librarian: long light hair, glasses, modest light blouse and long skirt, carrying books, axe and round shield for defending library. Fully clothed, friendly scholarly face.
assets.biblo: Biblo from One Piece, huge round brown-and-tan owl librarian with large expressive eyes, little hornlike feather tufts and spread wings, clutching a book. No human body.
assets.shakky: Shakuyaku also called Shakky from One Piece present day, adult woman with short black bob, triangular side bangs, pink blouse with spider motif, dark trousers and boots. Confident hand-to-hand fighter.
assets.ginny: Ginny from One Piece as adult Revolutionary commander, short pink hair, freckles, goggles on head, purple shirt and shorts, boots, radio and rifle. Fully clothed athletic adult.
assets.loki-animal: Loki transformed into Nidhoggr from One Piece: massive black western dragon, long serpentine neck, horned head, huge wings, scaled body, clawed legs, lightning crackling near mouth. Entire coiled tail and folded wings visible.
assets.killingham-animal: Killingham transformed into a mythical Kirin: quadruped dragon horse qilin, extremely long neck, one horn, blue-green scales, flowing pale mane, cloven hooves, dark flame-like clouds framing head, orange respirator at snout. Not a human.
assets.killingham-hybrid: Killingham hybrid Kirin warrior: tall humanoid in orange military coat and black trousers, long scaled neck and one-horned qilin dragon head, pale mane, orange respirator, dark cloud sash, clawed hands and kicking stance.
assets.im-gunko: Imu possessing adult Gunko: light blue bob, ringed red eyes, black military cap, black fur-collar military jacket, shorts and tall boots, black bat wings and dark arrow ribbons. Gunko body, no crown.
assets.im-revealed: Nerona Imu revealed devil form: muscular dark-skinned adult male, very long white hair over left eye, ringed red eyes, two curled black horns, black nails, eye-shaped circuit tattoos on forearms, jagged tattoo on left face and torso, white skin dots, open black cloak, fur belt with two rings, baggy dark pants, pointed shoes.

assets.roger-young: Gol D. Roger at God Valley age 39: wild black hair, thick curved black mustache, open red pirate captain coat with gold epaulets, dark shirt and trousers, yellow sash, saber Ace, fierce grin. Young vigorous adult, no hat.
assets.rayleigh-young: Silvers Rayleigh in God Valley: young athletic adult, swept blond hair, short blond facial hair, round glasses, open light shirt, dark trousers and boots, flowing cloak, straight sword. Not white-haired.
assets.gaban-young: Scopper Gaban at God Valley: fit young adult with long black ponytail, round sunglasses, open patterned shirt exposing muscular chest, loose dark pants, wielding TWO small axes, no gray hair.
assets.newgate-young: Edward Newgate young Whitebeard in God Valley: tall muscular adult with long flowing blond hair and iconic white crescent mustache, open dark pirate vest, light trousers, sash, huge bisento polearm. No medical equipment, no headscarf.
assets.bigmom-young: Charlotte Linlin at God Valley age 30: tall athletic adult woman, long pink hair, red pirate hat and open pink captain coat over modest fitted red dress, boots, sword Napoleon. Young powerful adult, not elderly rotund Big Mom.
assets.kaido-young: Kaido at God Valley age 21: muscular young adult, long black hair, curved horns, no mustache or beard, open blue sleeveless vest, dark pants, wristbands, large iron kanabo. No dragon body.
assets.shiki-young: Shiki the Golden Lion at God Valley: young adult, extremely long flowing blond hair, striped orange robe and dark cape, two normal human legs in sandals, dual swords in HANDS. No steering wheel in head, no prosthetic sword legs.
assets.xebec-young: Rocks D. Xebec in God Valley: fierce adult pirate captain, wild two-tone dark and pale swept-up hair, narrow eyes and facial scars, dark open captain coat with shoulder ornaments, light sash, trousers and boots, curved sword. Recognizable pirate, no silhouette.
assets.garling-young: Young Figarland Garling at God Valley: handsome adult swordsman, tall crescent-shaped blond hair with two side spikes, no long beard, white high collar uniform with gold closures, dark cape, gloves and boots, saber. Shanks-like facial structure.
assets.bogard-young: Young Bogard at God Valley: reserved adult Marine swordsman, brown fedora hiding eyes, tan double-breasted coat and suit, white shirt with blue tie, brown shoes, katana ready to draw. No beard.
assets.dragon-young: Monkey D. Dragon at God Valley as young adult Marine cadet age 17: lean athletic teenager, short spiky black hair, no facial tattoo, white Marine shirt and navy trousers, simple cap, boots, rifle lowered, determined protective stance. Fully clothed.
assets.bakkin-young: Miss Buckingham Stussy in the Rocks Pirates at God Valley: adult blonde woman, long curly hair, dark round hat, purple patterned pirate dress, dark gloves and boots, short cape, graceful confident fighter. This is young Bakkin, NOT the CP0 clone with bat wings.
assets.gloriosa-young: Young Gloriosa, adult Kuja empress at God Valley: tall athletic woman, long pale pink hair with flower, sleeveless purple patterned Chinese-style dress with trousers underneath, large coiled snake companion used as staff. No old wrinkles, no hunched back.
assets.john-young: Captain John ALIVE at God Valley: thin adult pirate, long pale lavender hair, black mustache, red captain coat with gold trim, white shirt, blue pants, brown boots, sword and bottle. Normal living skin, no zombie stitches.
assets.streusen-young: Streusen at God Valley, younger short stocky male pirate chef: brown curly hair, long curled mustache, chef hat, white shirt, brown apron and trousers, kitchen cleaver. No elder wrinkles.
assets.kuma-young: Bartholomew Kuma at God Valley age 9: tall sturdy boy with curly dark hair, simple worn white shirt and dark shorts, bare lower legs, open hands with pink paw pads, determined gentle expression. Fully clothed, no shackles, no wounds or blood.
assets.ivankov-young: Emporio Ivankov at God Valley age 15: energetic teen with purple curly afro, bold face makeup, striped simple shirt and shorts, boots, defiant clenched fists. Fully clothed and age appropriate, no revealing costume.
assets.ginny-young: Ginny at God Valley age 13: cheerful young girl with short pink hair, freckles, simple light shirt, shorts and boots, holding a small radio and a meat drumstick. Fully clothed, no wounds, child-appropriate adventurous sprite.
assets.shakky-young: Shakuyaku at God Valley age 24: young adult Kuja empress with black bob and triangular side bangs, purple Kuja blouse and trousers, short cape and boots, fists raised. Fully clothed, elegant formidable fighter, no chains.
assets.saturn-young: Jaygarcia Saturn during God Valley: heavyset elder-looking male with long gray dreadlocks, full gray beard, black cap, dark suit with open white shirt, black coat and wooden cane. Retain canon old appearance even 38 years ago, no invented youthful face.
assets.gunko-young: Manmayer Gunko during God Valley, adult woman who has not visibly aged: light blue bob, black cap and goggles, dark military tunic, short pants and tall boots, cloak, arrow ribbon gauntlets. No devil wings. Appearance of a Devoted Blade.
assets.sommers-young: Shepherd Sommers young at God Valley: muscular adult with long orange-blond pigtails, ordinary clear glasses, clean-shaven face with cross mark on chin, high collar purple military tunic, cape, gloves and boots, WHITE thorn-covered mace.
assets.saturn-hybrid: Jaygarcia Saturn Gyuki HYBRID form: elderly human upper body with long gray dreadlocks and gray beard, glaring eyes, huge black curved ox horns, dark suit jacket, enormous lower body of a black-and-red spider with eight segmented pointed legs. assets.saturn-beast: Jaygarcia Saturn complete Gyuki yokai: huge monstrous ox-spider with snarling bull head, enormous curved black horns, dark fur, eight massive black spider legs marked with red stripes, black flame cloud ring. No human torso. Entire legs inside each cell.

Keep entire body and wings inside each cell.

assets.nusjuro-hybrid: Ethanbaron V. Nusjuro Bakotsu HYBRID centaur: bald elder human swordsman upper body with round glasses and white kimono, long katana, lower body a skeletal horse with four bony legs and dark mane, freezing pale-blue mist and black flame sash. Not a rider sitting on a horse.
